skip.高等学校|こうとうがっこう: full form of 高校; noted there

あ|あ.notes: Jisho prints no pos label on the あっ/あ entry; set by hand (same as N5 いいえ).

合う|あう.tip: Not 会う (to meet people). 合う is things fitting together: 色が合う, 意見が合う, 答えが合う.

あかちゃん|あかちゃん.notes: Kana spelling; 赤 is an N4 kanji, so 赤ちゃん is the taught spelling.

上がる|あがる.usage: 階段を上がる、どうぞ上がってください
上がる|あがる.tip: Intransitive pair of 上げる (N5). どうぞ上がってください: please come in (stepping up from the entrance). 雨が上がる: the rain stops.
上がる|あがる.notes: Taught spelling; part 1's 上る|あがる carries alt here.

上る|あがる.notes: Tanos okurigana 上る; JMdict lists it as a variant of 上がる, which is taught. Not 上る のぼる (N5 登る).

赤ん坊|あかんぼう.tip: 赤ちゃん is the everyday, affectionate word; 赤ん坊 is plainer and a bit old-fashioned. Both come from 赤 (red), newborns being red-faced.

空く|あく.tip: Same sound as 開く (a door opens, N5) but 空く is about emptiness: 席が空く a seat frees up, 手が空く one's hands are free. Read すく it means to get less crowded, and おなかが空く is being hungry.
空く|あく.notes: JMdict files 空く あく in the same entry as 開く; N5 teaches 開く as to open. Intransitive; 空ける is the transitive pair.

あげる|あげる.notes: Kana spelling of 上げる, taught at N5. The giving sense is usually written in kana.

浅い|あさい.tip: Opposite of 深い (deep). Works for water, sleep (眠りが浅い), and knowledge or experience.

集まる|あつまる.tip: Intransitive: 人が集まる (people gather). Gathering things yourself is 集める.
集まる|あつまる.notes: Taught spelling; part 1's 集る carries alt here.

集る|あつまる.notes: Tanos okurigana; 集まる is standard and taught. Intransitive: 人が集まる. Also read たかる (to swarm), a different word.

集める|あつめる.tip: Transitive: 切手を集める. 集まる is the intransitive pair: 人が集まる (people gather).

安心|あんしん.usage: 安心する、安心してください

安全|あんぜん.tip: Opposite of 危険 (danger). Both work as な-adjectives: 安全な, 危険な.

あんな|あんな.tip: Fourth of the set: こんな (like this), そんな (like that, near you), あんな (like that, over there or shared memory), どんな (what kind of). Not the same as あの + noun: あんな人 = that kind of person.

以下|いか.tip: 以下 includes the number itself: 十人以下 is ten or fewer. Pair with 以上 (ten or more). At the top of a list, 以下 means the following.
以下|いか.notes: Bound: always after a number or noun. JMdict labels it noun used as a suffix.

contexts: [日曜日|にちようび][以外|いがい]
以外|いがい.tip: Noun + 以外: everything except that noun. 以外に also means in addition to, so check the sentence. Opposite in form: 以内 (within).
以外|いがい.notes: Bound: always after a noun. JMdict labels it noun used as a suffix.

医学|いがく.tip: The subject, not the pills: medicine you take is 薬 (N5). 医学部 is a medical faculty.

生きる|いきる.tip: 生きる is being alive; 住む (N5) is living somewhere. Opposite: 死ぬ.

意見|いけん.usage: 意見を言う、意見が合う

いじめる|いじめる.notes: Usually in kana; the kanji 苛める / 虐める are rare. いじめ is the noun (bullying).

contexts: [三|さん][人|にん][以上|いじょう]
[十八|じゅうはっ][歳|さい][以上|いじょう]
[一|いち][時間|じかん][以上|いじょう]
以上|いじょう.tip: 以上 includes the number itself: 三人以上 is three or more. Said alone at the end of a talk or an order, 以上です means that is all.
以上|いじょう.notes: Bound: after a number or noun. JMdict labels it noun used as a suffix.

致す|いたす.usage: お願いいたします、失礼いたします
致す|いたす.tip: Humble form of する: you lower yourself to raise the listener. よろしくお願いいたします, 失礼いたします. Usually written in kana.

一度|いちど.tip: 一度も + negative: never once. もう一度 (N5): once more.

一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい.usage: 一生懸命勉強する、一生懸命に
一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい.tip: Literally staking one's life on it. Used as an adverb (一生懸命働く) or with な (一生懸命な人).
一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい.notes: JMdict lists adverb first; left as adverb.

いっぱい|いっぱい.usage: おなかがいっぱい、人がいっぱい、ビールを一杯
いっぱい|いっぱい.tip: Two uses: おなかがいっぱい (full), 人がいっぱい (lots of). Written 一杯 it is also one cup or glass: ビールを一杯.
いっぱい|いっぱい.notes: Kana spelling taught (杯 is not an N4 kanji); the list's 一杯|いっぱい should carry alt pointing here. JMdict pos is noun first; the adjective sense is 'full'.

contexts: [一|いっ][週間|しゅうかん][以内|いない]
[一|いち][時間|じかん][以内|いない]
以内|いない.tip: Number + 以内: not past that limit, the limit itself included. 一週間以内に返す: return it within a week.
以内|いない.notes: Bound: always after a number or noun. JMdict lists noun first; set to suffix like 以上 / 以下 so quizzes ask it in a context.

田舎|いなか.tip: Also means where your family is from: 田舎に帰る (go back to my hometown).
田舎|いなか.notes: Jukujikun reading: the kanji do not read individually.

いらっしゃる|いらっしゃる.tip: Honorific for いる, 来る and 行く: it raises the other person. The ます-form is irregular: いらっしゃいます, and いらっしゃい is the greeting in shops. Humble side: おる, 参る.
いらっしゃる|いらっしゃる.notes: Kana only. JMdict label 'Godan verb - -aru special class' maps to verb-godan.

受ける|うける.usage: 試験を受ける、授業を受ける
受ける|うける.tip: The exam verb: 試験を受ける (take a test), not 取る. Also for receiving something aimed at you: 影響を受ける, 電話を受ける.

動く|うごく.tip: Intransitive: 車が動く. 動かす moves something. For machines 動く means it runs: 時計が動かない (the clock stopped working).

打つ|うつ.usage: ボールを打つ、メールを打つ

美しい|うつくしい.tip: きれい (N5) covers pretty and clean; 美しい is stronger, about beauty itself, and a little more written.

写す|うつす.usage: ノートを写す、写真を写す
写す|うつす.tip: Transitive. Same sound as 移す (to move something) and 映す (to project, reflect); 写す is copying or capturing an image.

移る|うつる.usage: 東京に移る、風邪が移る
移る|うつる.tip: Intransitive: 席が移る. 移す moves something. Also a cold passing from person to person: 風邪が移った.

腕|うで.tip: Also skill, as in a good pair of hands: 腕がいい (skilled). 手 (N5) can mean the whole arm in casual speech.

裏|うら.tip: 裏 and 表 are the two sides of one thing: a page, a building, a coin. 後ろ (N5) is the space behind something.

売り場|うりば.usage: おもちゃ売り場、三階の売り場

うん|うん.tip: Casual yes between friends; the polite answer is はい. Do not mix it up with ううん (casual no), which is longer with a falling tone.
うん|うん.notes: Jisho prints no pos label on this entry; set by hand.

運転手|うんてんしゅ.tip: 運転 (driving) + 手 (hand, person). 運転手さん is how you address a taxi driver.

遠慮|えんりょ.tip: 遠慮する is holding back out of politeness, often a polite no. 遠慮なくどうぞ: go ahead, no need to hold back. ご遠慮ください on a sign: please refrain.

おいでになる|おいでになる.tip: Same job as いらっしゃる: a respectful いる, 来る or 行く. おいでください is a warm please come; おいで alone is what you say to a child or a pet.
おいでになる|おいでになる.notes: JMdict labels it expression + godan; pos set to verb-godan so it conjugates like いらっしゃる. The kanji お出でになる is rare, and the entry is not flagged common.

お祝い|おいわい.usage: お祝いをする、お祝いを言う
お祝い|おいわい.tip: The noun of 祝う (to celebrate). お祝いに: as a celebration, as a gift to mark it.

おかげ|おかげ.usage: おかげさまで、～のおかげで
おかげ|おかげ.tip: ～のおかげで: thanks to, for good results. For bad results it is ～のせいで. おかげさまで is the set reply when someone asks how you or your family are doing.
おかげ|おかげ.notes: Kana spelling taught (陰 is not an N4 kanji); the list's お陰|おかげ should carry alt pointing here. JMdict entry お陰 is not flagged common; the matched sense is assistance / help.

おかしい|おかしい.tip: Two sides: funny as in laughable, and funny as in strange. おかしいな: something is off here.
おかしい|おかしい.notes: Kana; the kanji 可笑しい is rare.

億|おく.tip: Japanese counts in groups of four digits: 万 (10^4), 億 (10^8), 兆 (10^12). 一億 is 100,000,000.

贈り物|おくりもの.tip: The formal word; プレゼント is the everyday one. From 贈る (to give as a gift), not 送る (to send).

送る|おくる.usage: メールを送る、駅まで送る
送る|おくる.tip: Two everyday senses: sending a thing (荷物を送る) and taking a person somewhere (駅まで送ります).

遅れる|おくれる.usage: 電車が遅れる、会議に遅れる
遅れる|おくれる.tip: 遅れる is being late for something (に); 遅い (N5) is the adjective. 遅刻する is the noun-verb for arriving late.

起こす|おこす.usage: 七時に起こしてください、事故を起こす
起こす|おこす.tip: Transitive pair of 起きる (N5): 子供を起こす (wake the child). Also to cause: 事故を起こす (to cause an accident).
起こす|おこす.notes: Taught spelling; part 1's 起す carries alt here.

起す|おこす.notes: Tanos okurigana; 起こす is standard and taught. Transitive pair of 起きる (N5).

行う|おこなう.usage: 会議を行う、試験を行う
行う|おこなう.tip: A formal する: notices and news say 試験を行います where speech says します. Also written 行なう.

怒る|おこる.tip: Both getting angry and scolding: 母が怒っている (she is angry), 母に怒られた (I got told off). Same sound as 起こる (to happen).

押し入れ|おしいれ.tip: The deep closet with sliding doors where futons go in the daytime. From 押す (push) + 入れる (put in).

お嬢さん|おじょうさん.tip: Polite for someone else's daughter, or to address a young woman. Your own daughter is 娘.

お宅|おたく.tip: Polite word for the listener's home or family: お宅はどちらですか. The slang for an obsessive fan grew out of this word but is written オタク.

落ちる|おちる.usage: 財布が落ちる、試験に落ちる
落ちる|おちる.tip: Intransitive: 葉が落ちる. 落とす drops something. Also failing: 試験に落ちる.

落る|おちる.notes: Tanos old okurigana 落る; JMdict lists it as a variant of 落ちる, which is taught.

おっしゃる|おっしゃる.tip: Honorific of 言う, for what the other person says, never for yourself (humble: 申す). ます-form: おっしゃいます. お名前は何とおっしゃいますか: what is your name?
おっしゃる|おっしゃる.notes: Kana; the kanji 仰る is rare in learner texts. JMdict label 'Godan verb - -aru special class' maps to verb-godan.

夫|おっと.tip: 夫 is your own husband; someone else's is ご主人. Your own wife is 妻 or 家内, someone else's is 奥さん.

おつり|おつり.notes: Kana spelling; 釣 is not an N4 kanji (お釣り).

音|おと.tip: 音 is any sound; 声 (N5) is a voice. 音がする: there is a sound.

落とす|おとす.usage: 財布を落とす、スピードを落とす
落とす|おとす.tip: Transitive: 財布を落とした (I dropped, and probably lost, my wallet). 落ちる is the thing falling by itself.

落す|おとす.notes: Tanos old okurigana 落す; JMdict lists it as a variant of 落とす, which is taught.

驚く|おどろく.tip: 驚く is the plain verb; びっくりする is the everyday spoken version.

お祭り|おまつり.notes: JMdict flags the plain 祭り as common; お祭り is the everyday polite form and is the entry matched here.

お見舞い|おみまい.tip: Visiting someone in hospital, or the gift and card you bring. Also used after disasters: 地震のお見舞い.

gloss: gift brought back from a trip
お土産|おみやげ.tip: A gift you bring others from a trip, usually local food, not a keepsake for yourself. Also the small gift you bring when visiting a home.
お土産|おみやげ.notes: Jukujikun: 土産 reads みやげ.

思い出す|おもいだす.tip: 覚える (N5) is putting something into memory; 思い出す is pulling it back out. 思い出 is a memory.

思う|おもう.tip: Quoted thought: 行こうと思います (I think I'll go). 考える is working something out; 思う is an impression or feeling.

おもちゃ|おもちゃ.notes: Kana; the kanji 玩具 is rare.

表|おもて.tip: 表 and 裏 are the two faces of one thing: paper, a coin, a building. Read ひょう the same kanji is a table or chart.

親|おや.tip: 親 is the general word, 両親 (N5) means both parents. 親子: parent and child.

泳ぎ方|およぎかた.tip: Verb stem + 方 makes how to: 泳ぎ方, 読み方, 使い方. The pattern matters more than this one word.
泳ぎ方|およぎかた.notes: JMdict has the entry but does not flag it common; kept as the list's worked example of ～方.

下りる|おりる.notes: Same JMdict entry as 降りる, taught at N5 (getting off a vehicle). 下りる is the spelling for going down stairs or a hill.

折る|おる.tip: Transitive: 紙を折る, 骨を折る. 折れる is the thing breaking or folding by itself. 折り紙 is origami.

お礼|おれい.usage: お礼を言う、お礼の手紙
お礼|おれい.tip: お礼を言う: to say thank you. お礼 is also the gift or money you give to show thanks.

折れる|おれる.usage: 枝が折れる、骨が折れる
折れる|おれる.tip: Intransitive: 枝が折れた. Compare 折る (you break or fold it). 骨が折れる also means hard work.

終わり|おわり.usage: 今日はこれで終わり、月の終わり
終わり|おわり.tip: Noun from 終わる (N5). 終わりに: at the end. Opposite: 始め.

会議|かいぎ.usage: 会議をする、会議に出る

会場|かいじょう.usage: 試験会場、コンサート会場

帰り|かえり.usage: 帰りに買う、帰りが遅い
帰り|かえり.tip: Noun from 帰る (N5). 帰りに: on the way home. 行き (going) is its pair.

変える|かえる.tip: Transitive: 予定を変える. 変わる is the thing changing by itself. Same sound as 帰る (go home) and 替える (swap), so the kanji carries the meaning.

科学|かがく.tip: 科学 (science) and 化学 (chemistry) sound the same; people say ばけがく for chemistry to tell them apart.

飾る|かざる.tip: Transitive: 花を飾る (put flowers out). 飾り is a decoration.

火事|かじ.tip: 火 is fire as a thing; 火事 is a fire as an accident. 火事だ! means Fire!

堅い|かたい.notes: One JMdict entry covers 固い / 堅い / 硬い. None of the three kanji is N4, and the list has no kana key, so one spelling is taught: 固い, the broadest. 堅い leans to solid and dependable (堅い商売, 堅い木).

硬い|かたい.notes: Variant spelling for physical hardness (硬い石, 硬い表情); taught via 固い.

固い|かたい.usage: 固いパン、固い約束、頭が固い
固い|かたい.tip: Three kanji, one word. 固い is the general one (固いパン, 固い約束); 硬い stresses physical hardness (rock, stiff shoulders); 堅い is solid and dependable (wood, a steady job). Opposite: 柔らかい.
固い|かたい.notes: UNSURE: chose 固い as the taught spelling (the most general use); none of the three kanji is in the N4 kanji set and there is no kana key.

片付ける|かたづける.tip: Transitive: 部屋を片付ける. 片付く is the room being tidy by itself. 掃除 (N5) is cleaning dirt; 片付ける is putting things where they belong.

課長|かちょう.tip: Company ranks: 社長 (president) > 部長 (department head) > 課長 (section chief). Used as a title after the name: 田中課長.

勝つ|かつ.tip: Win a match: 試合に勝つ (に, not を). Opposite: 負ける.

家内|かない.tip: Humble word for your own wife, now a little old-fashioned; 妻 is the neutral word. Someone else's wife is 奥さん (N5).

悲しい|かなしい.tip: Opposite: うれしい (glad). 悲しむ is the verb, 悲しみ the noun.

必ず|かならず.tip: A promise word: 必ず来ます (I will come, no matter what). きっと is a confident guess; 必ず is a guarantee. 必ずしも + negative: not necessarily.

金持ち|かねもち.usage: お金持ち、金持ちになる
金持ち|かねもち.tip: Usually said with お: お金持ち. Literally money-holder.
金持ち|かねもち.notes: JMdict has 金持ち and お金持ち as separate common entries; the bare form is taught and お金持ち points here. Neither entry carries a JLPT tag.

お金持ち|おかねもち.notes: Polite お + 金持ち, the everyday spoken form. Taught via 金持ち.

彼女|かのじょ.tip: Pronoun she, and as a noun, girlfriend: 彼女がいる (I have a girlfriend). In speech people use names more than 彼 / 彼女.

髪|かみ.tip: 髪 is only the hair on your head; 毛 is any hair or fur. Same sound as 紙 (paper, N5) and 神 (god).

噛む|かむ.usage: よく噛んで食べる、犬に噛まれる

通う|かよう.usage: 学校に通う、会社に通う
通う|かよう.tip: Going somewhere repeatedly: 学校に通う (attend school), 病院に通う (go to the hospital regularly). One-off going is 行く.

彼|かれ.tip: Pronoun he, and as a noun, boyfriend: 彼がいる. Rarer in speech than in textbooks; names and titles do the job.

乾く|かわく.tip: Intransitive: 洗濯物が乾く. 乾かす dries something. 渇く (same sound) is being thirsty: のどが渇く.

代わり|かわり.tip: ～の代わりに: instead of, or in return for. お代わり is a second helping of food or drink.

変わる|かわる.usage: 天気が変わる、気が変わる
変わる|かわる.tip: Intransitive: 天気が変わる. 変える is changing something. 変わった人: an unusual person.

考える|かんがえる.usage: よく考える、～について考える
考える|かんがえる.tip: 思う is a feeling or impression; 考える is working something out in your head: よく考えてから決める.

関係|かんけい.tip: 関係ない: nothing to do with it, none of your business. 人間関係: human relationships.

看護師|かんごし.tip: The current official word for a nurse of any gender. 看護婦 (female nurse) is the older word you still hear.

簡単|かんたん.tip: な-adjective: 簡単な. Opposite: 複雑 (complicated) or 難しい.

気|き.usage: 気をつける、気に入る、気がする
気|き.tip: Rarely alone; lives in set phrases: 気をつける (be careful), 気に入る (take a liking to), 気がする (have a feeling), 気が合う (get along). 気分 and 気持ち grow out of it.

機会|きかい.usage: いい機会、機会があれば
機会|きかい.tip: Same sound as 機械 (machine); context tells them apart. 機会があれば: if I get the chance.

危険|きけん.tip: Opposite of 安全. As an adjective it takes な: 危険な. 危ない (N5) is the everyday word, 危険 the formal one on signs.

聞こえる|きこえる.usage: 音が聞こえる、聞こえますか
聞こえる|きこえる.tip: 聞こえる is a sound reaching you whether you try or not (音が聞こえる); 聞ける is being able to listen on purpose. Same pattern as 見える / 見られる.

汽車|きしゃ.tip: Old-fashioned: today's trains are 電車 (N5). You meet 汽車 in songs and stories, and for long-distance diesel trains.

技術|ぎじゅつ.usage: 技術が高い、新しい技術

季節|きせつ.usage: 季節が変わる、好きな季節

規則|きそく.usage: 規則を守る、学校の規則
規則|きそく.notes: The JMdict entry carries no JLPT tag (Tanos lists it at N4).

きっと|きっと.tip: A confident guess: きっと来るよ (I'm sure he'll come). 必ず is a promise; たぶん (N5) is a weaker guess.
きっと|きっと.notes: Kana; the kanji 屹度 is never used.

絹|きぬ.tip: Materials set: 絹 (silk), 木綿 (cotton), 毛 (wool).

厳しい|きびしい.usage: 厳しい先生、厳しい寒さ
厳しい|きびしい.tip: People (strict teacher), conditions (harsh winter), and situations (a tough schedule). Opposite for people: 優しい.

気分|きぶん.usage: 気分がいい、気分が悪い
気分|きぶん.tip: 気分 is your overall mood or physical state: 気分が悪い (I feel sick). 気持ち is a feeling about something or a bodily sensation: 気持ちがいい (feels good).

決まる|きまる.tip: Intransitive: 旅行の日が決まった (the trip date was set). Deciding it yourself is 決める.
決まる|きまる.notes: Taught spelling though 決 is not on the N4 kanji list: no kana key exists. Part 1's 決る carries alt here.

決る|きまる.notes: Tanos okurigana; 決まる is standard and taught. Intransitive pair of 決める. Read しゃくる (to scoop) it is a different word.

gloss: you (casual, to someone close or junior)
君|きみ.tip: Casual you, used downward or between close friends, often by men; it can sound bossy. Safer to use the person's name + さん. As a suffix the same kanji reads くん.

決める|きめる.tip: Transitive: 日にちを決める. 決まる is the matter being settled by itself: 日にちが決まった. ～ことにする also means deciding to.

気持ち|きもち.usage: 気持ちがいい、気持ちが悪い、気持ちを伝える
気持ち|きもち.tip: 気持ち is a feeling about something or a bodily sensation (気持ちがいい: feels good; 気持ち悪い: gross). 気分 is your overall mood.

着物|きもの.tip: Literally a thing to wear (着る + 物). 着物を着る: to wear a kimono. Western clothes are 洋服 (N5).

客|きゃく.tip: Almost always お客さん or お客様 in speech, whether a shop customer or a guest at home.

急|きゅう.tip: な-adjective: 急な用事 (urgent business), 急な坂 (steep hill). 急に: suddenly. The same kanji is in 急ぐ (hurry) and 急行 (express).

急行|きゅうこう.tip: Train ranks: 普通 / 各駅停車 (stops everywhere) < 急行 (express) < 特急 (limited express). Check the sign before boarding.
急行|きゅうこう.notes: JMdict lists noun + suru first (to hurry somewhere); the train sense is what learners meet.

教育|きょういく.usage: 教育を受ける、学校教育

教会|きょうかい.tip: A Christian church. A Buddhist temple is お寺, a Shinto shrine 神社.

競争|きょうそう.usage: 競争する、競争が激しい

興味|きょうみ.tip: Takes に: 日本の歴史に興味があります. 趣味 is a hobby; 興味 is the interest itself.

近所|きんじょ.tip: Where you live and the people around it: 近所の人 (the neighbours). 近く (N5) is simply nearby.

具合|ぐあい.usage: 具合が悪い、具合はどうですか
具合|ぐあい.tip: 具合はどうですか asks how you are feeling, or how a machine is running. 具合が悪い: unwell, or not working right.

空気|くうき.usage: 空気がきれい、空気を読む
空気|くうき.tip: Air you breathe, and the mood in a room: 空気を読む (read the room).

空港|くうこう.tip: The usual word; 飛行場 is the older or smaller airfield.

首|くび.tip: 首 is the neck; in slang 首になる means getting fired (the head comes off). 頭 (N5) is the head.

雲|くも.tip: 雲 (cloud) and 蜘蛛 (spider) are both くも; the pitch differs, the kanji tells. 曇り (N5) is cloudy weather.

比べる|くらべる.tip: ～に比べて: compared with. 比べ物にならない: no comparison.

くれる|くれる.usage: 友達が本をくれた、～てくれる
くれる|くれる.tip: Giving toward me or my group: 友達が本をくれた. あげる is giving away from me, もらう is receiving. ～てくれる: someone does something for me. Irregular imperative: くれ.
くれる|くれる.notes: Kana only (呉れる is not used). JMdict label 'Ichidan verb - kureru special class' maps to verb-ichidan. The cache also holds 暮れる; the gloss match lands on the giving entry.

gloss: to come to an end (a day, a year)
暮れる|くれる.usage: 日が暮れる、年が暮れる
暮れる|くれる.tip: 日が暮れる: the sun goes down. 年が暮れる: the year ends. Not the same word as くれる (to give), despite the sound. Opposite: 明ける.

gloss: Mr. (casual, for a boy or junior)
contexts: Tanaka (a boy or a junior colleague)
Yamada (a boy or a junior colleague)
君|くん.tip: Lighter than さん: for boys, male friends, and people junior to you (also young women at some workplaces). Never for someone above you. The same kanji reads きみ as a pronoun.
君|くん.notes: Bound suffix; JMdict entry 君/くん. Gloss shares Mr with the JMdict sense. Name compounds are not JMdict entries, so the context readings are hand-checked (plain name readings, no sound change).

毛|け.tip: 毛 is any hair or fur, including wool; 髪 is only the hair on your head. 毛虫: caterpillar (hairy bug).

経済|けいざい.tip: 経済学 is economics as a subject; 経済的 is economical (cheap).

警察|けいさつ.usage: 警察を呼ぶ、警察に届ける
警察|けいさつ.tip: The police as a body or the station: 警察を呼ぶ (call the police). An individual officer is 警官 (N5) or 警察官; the local box is 交番.

景色|けしき.usage: 景色がいい、きれいな景色
景色|けしき.notes: Irregular reading: 色 reads しき here.

消しゴム|けしゴム.notes: Mixed script: 消し (消す, to erase) + ゴム (gum, rubber). The JMdict reading is けしゴム with katakana.

gloss: lodging (a room rented in a house)
下宿|げしゅく.tip: Renting a room in someone's house, often with meals, the classic student set-up. Also the verb: 下宿している. An apartment is アパート.

決して|けっして.tip: Always pairs with a negative: 決して忘れません (I will never forget). Stronger and more formal than 全然～ない.

けれど|けれど.notes: Shorter form of けれども, same JMdict entry; けれども is taught. The kana key matches the shared けれど/けれども entry.

けれども|けれども.tip: A softer but that joins two clauses, and can trail off politely at the end: 行きたいんですけれども… Short forms: けれど, けど. でも (N5) starts a new sentence; けれども joins two.
けれども|けれども.notes: JMdict lists conjunction first; left as conjunction.

原因|げんいん.usage: 事故の原因、原因を調べる
原因|げんいん.tip: 原因 is what caused something (an accident, a problem); 理由 is the reason someone gives. Pair: 原因と結果 (cause and effect).

けんか|けんか.usage: けんかする、けんかになる
けんか|けんか.tip: Any fight from a shouting match to fists: 兄とけんかした. A match in sport is 試合, war is 戦争.
けんか|けんか.notes: Kana spelling (喧嘩 is beyond N4 kanji). Suru noun; stays noun.

研究室|けんきゅうしつ.tip: At a Japanese university a professor's own room is a 研究室, even if nothing is being measured in it.

子|こ.notes: Primary gloss unavoidably equals N5 子供; 子 is the bare word (女の子, うちの子). JMdict also lists it as a suffix but it stands alone, so no contexts.

こう|こう.tip: The こ of こそあど as an adverb: こう (like this), そう (like that), ああ (like that over there), どう (how).
こう|こう.notes: Kana spelling of 斯う; the kanji is never used. Accept avoids 'this way' (N5 こちら) and 'so' (N5 そう).

工業|こうぎょう.tip: 工業 is making things in factories; 産業 is industry in general (farming, tourism and so on included).
工業|こうぎょう.notes: 'industry' alone is left to 産業.

高校|こうこう.notes: Short form of 高等学校 (skipped in this part, as N5 skipped ラジオカセット for ラジカセ). Everyone says 高校.

工場|こうじょう.tip: Read こうじょう for a big factory; こうば is the older reading you hear for a small workshop in town.

国際|こくさい.tip: A noun that sits in front of other nouns: 国際空港, 国際結婚. For 'internationally' use 国際的に.

心|こころ.tip: The heart as the seat of feeling, not the organ: 心から (from the bottom of my heart), 心配 (worry).

御主人|ごしゅじん.tip: Polite: use for another person's husband. Your own is 主人 or 夫.
御主人|ごしゅじん.notes: Almost always written ご主人 today; JMdict lists 御主人 as a form of the same entry. Also 'master of the house', not taught here.

故障|こしょう.tip: For machines and cars. People and bones use other words.

ご存じ|ごぞんじ.tip: The respectful way to ask if someone knows something: ご存じですか instead of 知っていますか.

答|こたえ.notes: Usually written 答え with okurigana; the list has 答, which JMdict also lists as a form.

ごちそう|ごちそう.usage: ごちそうする、ごちそうさまでした
ごちそう|ごちそう.tip: ごちそうする = to treat someone to a meal. ごちそうさま is what you say when you finish eating.
ごちそう|ごちそう.notes: Kana spelling of ご馳走; 馳 is beyond N4 so the kana is taught.

このあいだ|このあいだ.notes: Kana spelling of この間 (taught as the kanji item since 間 is an N5 kanji). JMdict labels it noun and adverb; taught as the adverb it is used as.

このごろ|このごろ.notes: Kana spelling of この頃; 頃 is beyond N4 so the kana is taught. No kanji key exists in the list.

細かい|こまかい.usage: 細かいお金、細かいことを気にする
細かい|こまかい.tip: 細かいお金 is small change (coins). 小さい is just small; 細かい is small and many, or fine-grained.
細かい|こまかい.notes: 'small' kept out of the primary gloss because it is N5 小さい's.

込む|こむ.tip: Usually in the ている form: 込んでいる (is crowded). Glued to another verb it means 'into': 飛び込む (jump in).
込む|こむ.notes: The Tanos hint 'to include' is wrong for the standalone verb; also written 混む.

米|こめ.tip: 米 is the grain you buy and wash; once cooked and on the table it is ご飯.

ごらんになる|ごらんになる.tip: The respectful version of 見る, used about what the other person sees: ご覧になりましたか. ご覧ください = please look.
ごらんになる|ごらんになる.notes: Kana spelling of ご覧になる (覧 beyond N4). JMdict labels it expression + godan verb; pos set to verb-godan since it conjugates like なる.

これから|これから.notes: JMdict's entry is 此れから, always written in kana. Pos stays expression as with N5 それから.

怖い|こわい.tip: Works both ways: 怖い映画 is a scary film, and 私は怖い means I am scared. Also written 恐い.

壊す|こわす.tip: Transitive: 時計を壊す (I broke the clock). The thing breaking by itself is 壊れる.

壊れる|こわれる.tip: Intransitive: 時計が壊れた (the clock broke). You breaking it is 壊す.

今度|こんど.usage: 今度の日曜日、また今度
今度|こんど.tip: Means 'this time' or 'next time' depending on context: 今度の試験 is the coming exam, また今度 is 'another time'.

今夜|こんや.notes: Primary gloss unavoidably equals N5 今晩; 今夜 is the slightly more written word.

探す|さがす.tip: Also written 捜す for searching for something lost or missing.

下がる|さがる.usage: 熱が下がる、値段が下がる
下がる|さがる.tip: Intransitive: 熱が下がる (the fever goes down). Bringing something down yourself is 下げる.
下がる|さがる.notes: Intransitive pair of 下げる. 下る alone is normally read くだる.

下る|さがる.notes: Tanos old okurigana 下る; JMdict lists it as a variant of 下がる, which is taught.

盛ん|さかん.tip: Popular in the sense of widely done: スポーツが盛んな国 is a country where sport is big. For a popular person use 人気がある.

下げる|さげる.usage: 頭を下げる、音を下げる
下げる|さげる.tip: Transitive: 値段を下げる (lower the price). The thing going down on its own is 下がる.

差し上げる|さしあげる.tip: Humble あげる: you give something to someone above you. お送りします is 送って差し上げます made shorter.

さっき|さっき.notes: JMdict labels it noun and adverb (kana form of 先); taught as the adverb. The homophone 殺気 is also marked common but shares no gloss word.

寂しい|さびしい.tip: Said さびしい or さみしい; both are fine in speech. Also written 淋しい.
寂しい|さびしい.notes: 'sad' kept out of accept since another part teaches 悲しい.

さ来月|さらいげつ.notes: JMdict spells it 再来月; 再 is beyond N4 so the list's さ来月 spelling is taught and matched via jmWord.

さ来週|さらいしゅう.notes: JMdict spells it 再来週; 再 is beyond N4 so the list's さ来週 spelling is taught and matched via jmWord.

触る|さわる.tip: Takes に, not を: 絵に触らないでください (please don't touch the paintings).

産業|さんぎょう.tip: Industry in the broad sense: 観光産業 (tourism industry), 自動車産業. Factory-type industry is 工業.

残念|ざんねん.tip: 残念ですね is the everyday 'that's too bad'; 残念ながら starts a sentence with 'unfortunately'.

市|し.tip: The administrative unit, mostly glued to a name: 横浜市. On its own it is 'the city' as a government: 市の図書館 (the city library). 町 is a town or the streets.
市|し.notes: JMdict: noun and noun-suffix. Mostly bound, so contexts are given; stands alone in 市の～.

字|じ.tip: Also handwriting: 字がきれい = nice handwriting.

試合|しあい.usage: 試合をする、試合に勝つ

仕方|しかた.tip: Lives mostly in 仕方がない (it can't be helped) and after a noun: 勉強の仕方 (how to study).

地震|じしん.tip: 自信 (confidence) and 自身 (oneself) are also じしん; context tells them apart.

時代|じだい.tip: After a noun it means 'the days of': 学生時代 = my student days.

しっかり|しっかり.usage: しっかり勉強する、しっかりしている
しっかり|しっかり.tip: しっかりしている describes a reliable, together person. Often しっかりと.
しっかり|しっかり.notes: Kana spelling of 確り (never written in kanji).

失敗|しっぱい.tip: 失敗する is to fail at something or mess up; the opposite is 成功する.

辞典|じてん.tip: 辞書 is the everyday word for a dictionary; 辞典 is the formal one you see in titles (国語辞典).
辞典|じてん.notes: Primary gloss unavoidably equals N5 辞書.

しばらく|しばらく.usage: しばらくお待ちください
しばらく|しばらく.tip: しばらくですね / お久しぶり: 'it's been a while'.

事務所|じむしょ.tip: The room or building where office work happens; the company itself is 会社.

自由|じゆう.tip: A na-adjective too: 自由な時間 (free time), 自由に (freely). Not to be confused with 十分 (じゅうぶん).

習慣|しゅうかん.tip: A personal habit or a social custom. Not 週間 (weeks), also しゅうかん.

十分|じゅうぶん.tip: Same kanji as 十分 (じっぷん, ten minutes). Also written 充分.

将来|しょうらい.tip: 将来 is your own future (career, dreams). The general future, as in weather or history, is 未来.

女性|じょせい.tip: The polite, neutral word for an adult woman; 女 on its own can sound blunt.
女性|じょせい.notes: Primary made distinct from N5 女 by the parenthetical.

神社|じんじゃ.tip: 神社 is a Shinto shrine with a torii gate; a Buddhist temple is お寺.

親切|しんせつ.notes: Another part teaches 優しい; 'kind' is the natural primary of both. Flag if it collides.

過ぎる|すぎる.usage: 食べすぎる、九時を過ぎる
過ぎる|すぎる.tip: After a verb stem or adjective it means 'too': 食べすぎる (eat too much), 高すぎる (too expensive).

凄い|すごい.tip: Good or bad, just extreme. すごく means 'very' in casual speech. Usually written in kana.
凄い|すごい.notes: Usually written すごい; the list has the kanji.

進む|すすむ.usage: まっすぐ進む、仕事が進む
進む|すすむ.tip: Intransitive: 仕事が進む (the work progresses). Pushing it forward yourself is 進める.

すっかり|すっかり.tip: Often with a change that is now total: すっかり忘れた (clean forgot), すっかり春だ (it's fully spring).

すっと|すっと.tip: A quick, smooth motion: すっと立つ (stand up smoothly). 気持ちがすっとした = I felt relieved.
すっと|すっと.notes: UNSURE: a sound-symbolic adverb that is rare for N4; kept because it is on the list.

滑る|すべる.tip: Also used for failing an exam in casual speech (試験に滑る), so students avoid the word before exams.

隅|すみ.tip: 隅 is the inside corner of a room or box; 角 (かど) is the outside corner, like a street corner.
隅|すみ.notes: Primary made distinct from N5 角 by the parenthetical.

済む|すむ.usage: 用事が済む、すみません
済む|すむ.tip: Intransitive: 仕事が済んだ (the work is done). Same reading as 住む (to live); the negative 済まない is behind すみません.

すり|すり.notes: Kana spelling of 掏摸, never written in kanji.

すると|すると.tip: Starts a sentence: what happened next, or 'in that case'. More written than それから.

生活|せいかつ.tip: Life as in daily living (生活費, living costs). Life as in being alive is 命 or 人生.

西洋|せいよう.tip: Europe and the Americas as a cultural block: 西洋料理 (Western food). The opposite is 東洋.

線|せん.tip: A drawn line, a wire, or a train line (山手線). Not 千 (thousand), also せん.

先輩|せんぱい.tip: Someone who joined the school, club or company before you, whatever their age. The opposite is 後輩.

育てる|そだてる.tip: Transitive: 子供を育てる (raise a child). Growing up by itself is 育つ.

卒業|そつぎょう.tip: Takes を: 大学を卒業する. The opposite is 入学 (entering a school).

祖父|そふ.tip: The plain word for your own grandfather when talking to others. おじいさん is for someone else's, or when speaking to him.

祖母|そぼ.tip: The plain word for your own grandmother when talking to others. おばあさん is for someone else's, or when speaking to her.

それで|それで.tip: Links a cause to what followed: 雨が降った。それで試合は中止になった. Also 'and then what?' when prompting a story: それで？
それで|それで.notes: Kana spelling of 其れで. 'so' kept out of accept (N5 そう).

それに|それに.tip: Adds another reason: 安い。それに、おいしい. (It's cheap. What's more, it's tasty.)

それほど|それほど.tip: Mostly with a negative: それほど難しくない (not that hard). そんなに is the casual spoken equivalent.

そろそろ|そろそろ.tip: The polite way to start leaving: そろそろ失礼します (I should be going).

そんな|そんな.tip: The そ of こんな / そんな / あんな / どんな. On its own, そんな！ is 'no way!'.

そんなに|そんなに.tip: Usually with a negative: そんなに難しくない (not that hard). Slightly more spoken than それほど.

退院|たいいん.tip: 退院する = to be discharged. Being admitted is 入院する.

大事|だいじ.tip: Almost the same as 大切. お大事に (take care) is what you say to someone who is ill.
大事|だいじ.notes: Primary gloss unavoidably equals N5 大切; they are near-synonyms.

大体|だいたい.notes: 'about' kept out of accept (N5 くらい).

たいてい|たいてい.notes: Kana spelling of 大抵. JMdict lists na-adjective first, then adverb and noun; taught as the adverb it is nearly always used as.

大分|だいぶ.tip: Usually written in kana (だいぶ); the kanji also spell the city Oita (おおいた).
大分|だいぶ.notes: 'a lot' kept out (N5 たくさん primary).

倒れる|たおれる.tip: Intransitive: 木が倒れた (the tree fell over), 父が倒れた (my father collapsed). Knocking something over is 倒す.

だから|だから.tip: The casual connector for 'so'. In polite speech it becomes ですから. On its own, だから！ is an exasperated 'like I said!'.

確か|たしか.tip: Two uses: 確かに = certainly, for sure; 確か at the start of a sentence = 'if I remember right' (確か三時だった).

足す|たす.usage: 二に三を足す、水を足す
足す|たす.tip: Adding a number or a bit more of something: 水を足す (top up the water). Having enough is 足りる.

訪ねる|たずねる.tip: Same reading as 尋ねる (to ask). 訪ねる has the 言 radical missing: you go there. 尋ねる has it: you use words.

尋ねる|たずねる.tip: A slightly formal 聞く for asking a question. Not 訪ねる (to visit), also たずねる.

畳|たたみ.tip: Also the counter for room size: 六畳 (ろくじょう) is a six-mat room.
畳|たたみ.notes: 'tatami' is an English dictionary loanword, not romaji for a Japanese gloss.

立てる|たてる.tip: Transitive 立つ: 本を立てる (stand the books up). Also 計画を立てる (make a plan). 建てる, same reading, is to build.

建てる|たてる.tip: Buildings only: 家を建てる. For making things in general use 作る. 立てる, same reading, is to stand something up.

楽しみ|たのしみ.tip: 楽しみにしています = I'm looking forward to it. As a noun: 楽しみは何ですか (what do you do for fun).

楽しむ|たのしむ.tip: Transitive: 音楽を楽しむ (enjoy music). 楽しい is the adjective 'fun'.

たまに|たまに.tip: Less often than 時々: 時々 is sometimes, たまに is only now and then.
たまに|たまに.notes: Kana spelling of 偶に. 'sometimes' kept out (N5 時々 primary).

為|ため.tip: Two jobs: purpose (試験のために勉強する, study for the exam) and cause (雨のため中止, cancelled because of rain). Almost always written ため.
為|ため.notes: JMdict: noun and adverb; stays noun. Written in kana in practice.

足りる|たりる.tip: Most used in the negative: 時間が足りない (not enough time). Ichidan: 足りて, 足りない.

男性|だんせい.tip: The polite, neutral word for an adult man; 男 on its own can sound blunt.
男性|だんせい.notes: Primary made distinct from N5 男 by the parenthetical.

暖房|だんぼう.tip: Heating a room. Cooling is 冷房; both are turned on with つける.

チェック|チェック.usage: チェックする、チェックイン
チェック|チェック.notes: Cache file fetched this session. JMdict's first sense is the pattern; all three senses are everyday.

ちっとも|ちっとも.tip: Always with a negative: ちっとも面白くない (not fun at all). A casual 全然.

ちゃん|ちゃん.tip: A softer さん for children, close friends and family: お母ちゃん, 花子ちゃん. 君 is the boys' version.

注意|ちゅうい.usage: 注意する、ご注意ください
注意|ちゅうい.tip: 注意する is both 'to be careful' (車に注意する) and 'to warn someone' (先生に注意された).

中学校|ちゅうがっこう.tip: Shortened to 中学 in speech; a pupil there is a 中学生.

注射|ちゅうしゃ.tip: Not 駐車 (parking), also ちゅうしゃ.

捕まえる|つかまえる.usage: 泥棒を捕まえる、タクシーを捕まえる
捕まえる|つかまえる.tip: Transitive: 犯人を捕まえる (catch the culprit). Getting caught is 捕まる.

付く|つく.tip: Intransitive つける: 汚れが付く (dirt sticks). 朝食が付く = breakfast is included. 気が付く = to notice.
付く|つく.notes: Intransitive pair of N5 つける. Lights coming on is usually written in kana (電気がつく).

漬ける|つける.tip: One of several つける: this one is for liquid, 野菜を漬ける (pickle vegetables). 漬物 are pickles.

都合|つごう.usage: 都合がいい、都合が悪い
都合|つごう.tip: Lives in 都合がいい (it suits me) and 都合が悪い (it doesn't suit me) when arranging times.

伝える|つたえる.usage: よろしくお伝えください
伝える|つたえる.tip: Transitive: passing a message along. よろしくお伝えください = please give them my regards. Getting through by itself is 伝わる.

続く|つづく.tip: Intransitive: 雨が続く (the rain continues). つづく at the end of an episode = to be continued. Keeping something going yourself is 続ける.

続ける|つづける.usage: 勉強を続ける、話し続ける
続ける|つづける.tip: Transitive: 勉強を続ける (keep studying). After a verb stem: 走り続ける (keep running).

妻|つま.tip: Your own wife when talking to others (家内 is the older word). Someone else's is 奥さん. Husband is 夫.
妻|つま.notes: JMdict also has garnish and a rare 'my dear' entry; only 'wife' is taught.

つもり|つもり.tip: Verb (dictionary form) + つもりです: I intend to. Negative: 行かないつもり or 行くつもりはない. Also used for a belief about oneself: 若いつもり (thinks of oneself as young).
つもり|つもり.notes: Kana spelling of 積もり; JMdict noun. Normally bound to a verb but つもりです stands on its own, so no contexts.

丁寧|ていねい.tip: Two uses: polite speech (丁寧な言葉) and careful, thorough work (丁寧に書く).

適当|てきとう.tip: Dictionary meaning: suitable (適当な大きさ). In everyday speech 適当にやる usually means doing it any old way, without care. Context decides.

手伝う|てつだう.tip: Takes を: 母を手伝う, 宿題を手伝う. Noun form 手伝い (help, helper).

寺|てら.tip: Usually said with お: お寺. Buddhist temples are 寺; Shinto shrines are 神社.

電灯|でんとう.tip: 電灯 is the lamp itself; 電気 is electricity, though 電気をつける also means switching the light on.

都|と.tip: Japan is divided into 都 (Tokyo), 道 (Hokkaido), 府 (Osaka, Kyoto) and 県 (the other prefectures). On its own と is only heard in these compounds.
都|と.notes: JMdict noun (also a counter for cities, not taught). Occurs only bound (東京都, 都内), hence contexts; pos left as JMdict's noun. Not the common reading みやこ (capital), which is a separate N3-level word.

とうとう|とうとう.tip: とうとう often has a sigh in it: the thing you expected (good or bad) finally happened. やっと is relief after effort; つい is doing something you did not mean to.
とうとう|とうとう.notes: Kana spelling of 到頭; the kanji are never used. Primary gloss differs from やっと (at last).

遠く|とおく.usage: 遠くに山が見える、遠くから来た
遠く|とおく.tip: 遠い is the adjective (far); 遠く is the noun or adverb form: 遠くへ行く, 遠くから. Same pattern as 近い / 近く.

通る|とおる.tip: Intransitive with を for the route: 公園を通る. 試験に通る means to pass an exam. The transitive pair 通す (to let through) is later.

とこや|とこや.notes: Kana spelling of 床屋; 床 is beyond N4, so kana is taught. Usually written 床屋 in print.

途中|とちゅう.usage: 学校へ行く途中、話の途中で

特急|とっきゅう.tip: Train speeds, slow to fast: 普通 (every station) < 急行 (express) < 特急 (limited express, fewest stops, often needs an extra ticket).

届ける|とどける.usage: 荷物を届ける、警察に届ける
届ける|とどける.tip: Transitive: 荷物を届ける. The intransitive pair 届く (to arrive, to reach) is the thing arriving by itself. Avoid typing to send: that is 送る (N5).
届ける|とどける.notes: Accept avoids "to send" to keep it apart from N5 送る.

泊まる|とまる.tip: Same sound as 止まる (to stop, N5) but 泊 is the water radical + 白: a night's lodging. 泊める is the transitive pair: to put someone up.

止める|とめる.usage: 車を止める、時計を止める
止める|とめる.tip: Transitive: 車を止める. 止まる (N5) is the car stopping by itself. Same kanji read やめる means to quit an activity: タバコをやめる.
止める|とめる.notes: Transitive pair of N5 止まる. 止める|やめる is a separate item in this part.

どんどん|どんどん.usage: どんどん増える、どんどん食べてください
どんどん|どんどん.tip: Fast and without stopping: どんどん上手になる. Also an invitation to go ahead freely: どんどん質問してください. だんだん is gradual, step by step.
どんどん|どんどん.notes: Mimetic; JMdict's first sense is the drumming noise, the taught senses are the second and third.

直す|なおす.usage: 自転車を直す、間違いを直す
直す|なおす.tip: Transitive: 時計を直す. 直る is the intransitive pair (it gets fixed). Written 治す it means to cure an illness. After a verb stem, 〜直す means to redo: 書き直す.

直る|なおる.tip: Intransitive: 時計が直る (it got fixed). 直す is you fixing it. Same sound as 治る, which is getting over an illness.
直る|なおる.notes: Intransitive pair of 直す. JMdict entry carries no JLPT tag but is common; Tanos lists it.

治る|なおる.tip: Intransitive: 病気が治る. 治す is the doctor curing it. 直る with the other kanji is a thing getting repaired; the sound is the same, the kanji tells you which.

泣く|なく.tip: 泣く is people crying. 鳴く (N5) is animals: birds sing, dogs bark, cats meow.

無くなる|なくなる.usage: お金が無くなる、かぎが無くなった
無くなる|なくなる.tip: Intransitive: 時間がなくなる (time runs out). 無くす is losing something yourself. With the kanji 亡 it is a person passing away.
無くなる|なくなる.notes: Usually written in kana (なくなる). Separate item from 亡くなる.

亡くなる|なくなる.tip: The gentle word for a person dying, like pass away; 死ぬ is blunt. Not used for animals or things. 無くなる (same sound) is things going missing.

なさる|なさる.tip: Honorific of する, for someone you respect: 先生がなさる. ます form is なさいます (not なさります). Imperative なさい is the parent-to-child command: 早く寝なさい.
なさる|なさる.notes: Kana spelling of 為さる. JMdict pos is the special -aru godan class (いらっしゃる, おっしゃる, くださる): godan with an irregular ます stem, hence pos verb-godan.

鳴る|なる.usage: 電話が鳴る、ベルが鳴る
鳴る|なる.tip: Intransitive: the phone rings by itself. 鳴らす is you ringing it. Not the なる of 先生になる (to become), which is written in kana.

なるべく|なるべく.usage: なるべく早く来てください
なるべく|なるべく.tip: Same meaning as できるだけ; なるべく is a touch softer, a request rather than a demand.
なるべく|なるべく.notes: Kana spelling of 成るべく; kanji never used.

なるほど|なるほど.tip: Said when something clicks: なるほど、そうですか. Treat it as casual; to a superior a plain そうですか or 分かりました is safer.
なるほど|なるほど.notes: Kana spelling of 成る程. JMdict labels it adverb; used as an interjection in practice.

慣れる|なれる.tip: Takes に: 仕事に慣れる. Verb + のに慣れる for an activity: 早く起きるのに慣れた.

苦い|にがい.usage: 苦いコーヒー、苦い経験
苦い|にがい.tip: The five tastes: 甘い sweet, 辛い spicy, 苦い bitter, 酸っぱい sour, 塩辛い salty. 苦しい (same kanji) is painful, suffering.

二階建て|にかいだて.tip: 〜建て after a floor count: 三階建て (three storeys), 十階建てのビル.

逃げる|にげる.usage: 泥棒が逃げた、質問から逃げる
逃げる|にげる.tip: Intransitive: 犬が逃げた. 逃がす is letting something escape.

日記|にっき.tip: The verb is つける: 日記をつける (keep a diary), not 書く alone, though 日記を書く is also heard.

入院|にゅういん.tip: 入院する: to go into hospital; 退院する: to leave hospital. Both take the hospital with に.

入学|にゅうがく.usage: 大学に入学する、入学式
入学|にゅうがく.tip: 入学する takes に: 大学に入学する. The opposite is 卒業 (graduation). 入学式 is the entrance ceremony in April.

似る|にる.tip: Almost always in the ている form: 母に似ている (I look like my mother), not 似る. Takes に (or と). Not 煮る (to simmer), same sound.

人形|にんぎょう.tip: 人形 is the usual word for a doll (ひな人形, 日本人形). 人間 (にんげん) with the other second kanji means human.

盗む|ぬすむ.tip: Often in the passive: 財布を盗まれた (I had my wallet stolen). The person is 泥棒.

塗る|ぬる.usage: 壁を塗る、パンにバターを塗る
塗る|ぬる.tip: 塗る covers a surface: paint on a wall, butter on bread, cream on skin. Painting a picture is 描く (かく).

ぬれる|ぬれる.tip: Intransitive: 雨で服がぬれた. 濡らす is wetting something on purpose. Opposite: 乾く (to dry).
ぬれる|ぬれる.notes: Kana spelling of 濡れる; 濡 is beyond N4 so the kana form is taught. The list also has 濡れる|ぬれる (another part): that key should carry alt pointing here.

ねだん|ねだん.usage: 値段が高い、値段を聞く
ねだん|ねだん.notes: Kana spelling of 値段; 値 is beyond N4 so kana is taught. Usually written 値段 in shops and print.

熱|ねつ.tip: 熱がある: to have a fever. 熱い (N5) is the adjective hot to the touch; 熱 alone is the heat or a fever.

寝坊|ねぼう.tip: 寝坊する: to oversleep. 寝坊 can also be the person: 彼は寝坊だ (he is a late riser).

眠い|ねむい.tip: 眠い is sleepy; 疲れた is tired from effort. 眠たい means the same as 眠い and is more casual.

眠る|ねむる.usage: ぐっすり眠る、よく眠れない
眠る|ねむる.tip: 寝る (N5) is going to bed or lying down, whether or not you sleep. 眠る is actually being asleep: ベッドで寝たが眠れなかった (I lay down but could not sleep).
眠る|ねむる.notes: Primary gloss kept off "to sleep" to stay apart from N5 寝る; "to sleep" accepted.

残る|のこる.usage: 会社に残る、ご飯が残る
残る|のこる.tip: Intransitive: 食べ物が残った (food was left over). 残す is leaving it yourself. 残業 (overtime) comes from staying on at work.

乗り換える|のりかえる.usage: 新宿で乗り換える、バスに乗り換える
乗り換える|のりかえる.tip: Take に for the new line: 地下鉄に乗り換える. The noun is 乗り換え (a transfer).

乗り物|のりもの.tip: Anything you ride: trains, buses, bikes, even fairground rides. From 乗る + 物.

葉|は.tip: Casually 葉っぱ. Same sound as 歯 (tooth, N5) and the particle は; the kanji keeps them apart.

場合|ばあい.usage: 雨の場合、遅れる場合は
場合|ばあい.tip: Noun + の場合 or verb + 場合: in the case of. 雨の場合は中止です (if it rains, it is cancelled). Compare 時 (when) for simple timing.

倍|ばい.tip: Number + 倍: 三倍 is three times as much. 倍 alone means double: 値段が倍になった (the price doubled).
倍|ばい.notes: Bound counter (JMdict noun / counter); contexts required. No sound changes for 1 to 10 (いちばい, さんばい, ろくばい, はちばい, じゅうばい).

拝見|はいけん.usage: 拝見します、お手紙を拝見しました
拝見|はいけん.tip: Humble form of 見る: lowers yourself when you look at something belonging to the listener. 拝見します: may I see it. Only for your own looking, never for what others see.
拝見|はいけん.notes: Noun / suru verb; pos left as noun per the brief. Humble (謙譲語), unlike ご覧になる (honorific).

歯医者|はいしゃ.tip: 歯 (tooth) + 医者 (doctor). Like 医者, it also names the place: 歯医者に行く (go to the dentist's).

運ぶ|はこぶ.tip: Moving things from place to place: 荷物を運ぶ. 持つ (N5) is simply holding or having. The kanji 運 is also in 運転 (driving) and 運動 (exercise).

始める|はじめる.usage: 仕事を始める、食べ始める
始める|はじめる.tip: Transitive: 授業を始める (the teacher starts the class). 始まる (N5) is the class starting by itself. Verb stem + 始める: to start doing: 降り始める (start to fall).
始める|はじめる.notes: Transitive pair of N5 始まる; glosses carry (something) to keep the primary apart.

場所|ばしょ.usage: 集まる場所、場所を取る
場所|ばしょ.tip: 場所 is a specific spot or location, a bit more concrete than 所 (N5): 会議の場所, 場所を取る (to save a spot, or to take up space).
場所|ばしょ.notes: Primary gloss "place" overlaps N5 所 (place / spot); they are near-synonyms and both accept the same word. UNSURE: if the orchestrator wants them apart, use "location" first.

はず|はず.usage: 来るはずです、そんなはずはない
contexts: it is supposed to be cheap
はず|はず.tip: Verb or adjective + はず: a confident expectation from evidence. 来るはずです (should come, I expect so). 〜はずがない: there is no way. Not a personal plan, which is つもり.
はず|はず.notes: Kana spelling of 筈. JMdict labels it auxiliary, not in the allowed pos list; filed as noun (it is a formal noun taking a modifier) and treated as bound, hence contexts.

恥ずかしい|はずかしい.usage: 恥ずかしい話、恥ずかしがる
恥ずかしい|はずかしい.tip: Covers both the feeling (I am embarrassed) and the cause (an embarrassing mistake), like many Japanese adjectives of feeling. 恥ずかしがる: to act shy.

はっきり|はっきり.usage: はっきり言う、はっきり見える
はっきり|はっきり.tip: Clear outlines, clear speech, clear memory: はっきり見える, はっきり言ってください. はっきりする: to become clear or certain.
はっきり|はっきり.notes: Mimetic; first JMdict sense is the adverb, the suru sense follows.

花見|はなみ.tip: Usually お花見. A spring picnic under the cherry trees, late March to April; the blossoms themselves are 桜.

林|はやし.tip: Two trees make 林 (woods), three make 森 (forest). 林 is smaller, often planted; 森 is deep and wild.

払う|はらう.usage: お金を払う、注意を払う
払う|はらう.tip: 払う is paying money: 代金を払う. Giving money back is 返す. 注意を払う (to pay attention) uses it the same way English does.

番組|ばんぐみ.usage: テレビ番組、ニュース番組

反対|はんたい.tip: Two jobs: 反対する (to oppose, with に: 計画に反対する) and 反対の (the opposite: 反対の意見, 反対側). 賛成 is the opposite of opposition.

日|ひ.usage: その日、日が出る、日が暮れる
日|ひ.tip: Read ひ, 日 is a day as a unit (その日, 休みの日) or the sun (日が出る). Read にち (N5) it counts dates. 太陽 is the sun as a star.
日|ひ.notes: Separate item from the N5 counter 日|にち; primary gloss "day" vs counter "day (in dates)".

火|ひ.tip: 火をつける: light a fire / turn on the stove; 火を消す: put it out. A house fire is 火事. 火曜日 (N5) uses the same kanji.

冷える|ひえる.usage: 体が冷える、夜は冷える
冷える|ひえる.tip: Intransitive: ビールが冷えている (the beer is chilled). 冷やす is chilling it yourself. For weather turning cold over time use 寒くなる.

光|ひかり.tip: 光 is light itself: 月の光, 光が見える. 電気 (N5) is the electric light you switch on. The verb is 光る.

光る|ひかる.tip: Intransitive: 星が光る. 照らす is shining a light on something.

引き出し|ひきだし.tip: From 引き出す (pull out): the thing you pull out of a desk. At a bank, 引き出し is a withdrawal.

ひきだす|ひきだす.usage: 引き出す：お金を引き出す
ひきだす|ひきだす.tip: 引く (pull) + 出す (take out). At the ATM: お金を引き出す. 預ける is putting money in.
ひきだす|ひきだす.notes: Kana key from the Tanos list; normally written 引き出す (引 is N4, 出 is N5) but the kanji key is not in the list, so no alt. Cache file ひきだす.json matches the JMdict reading.

ひげ|ひげ.tip: One word for beard, moustache and whiskers alike; ひげをそる is to shave. Specify with あごひげ (chin) or 口ひげ (lip) if it matters.

飛行場|ひこうじょう.tip: 飛行場 is the older, plainer word for an airfield; a big modern airport is 空港. Both are heard, 空港 far more today.
飛行場|ひこうじょう.notes: Primary gloss airfield to stay apart from 空港 (airport, another part); airport accepted.

accept: for the first time in a while
it has been a long time
久しぶり|ひさしぶり.usage: お久しぶりです、久しぶりに会う
久しぶり|ひさしぶり.tip: お久しぶりです: long time no see. As an adverb: 久しぶりに映画を見た (saw a film for the first time in ages).

美術館|びじゅつかん.tip: 美術館 shows art; 博物館 is a museum of history, science or nature.

非常に|ひじょうに.tip: A formal very, common in writing and speeches. とても is the everyday word. 非常 alone means an emergency: 非常口 (emergency exit).

引っ越す|ひっこす.tip: Intransitive: 大阪に引っ越した. The noun is 引っ越し (a move). Moving an object is 動かす or 運ぶ.

必要|ひつよう.usage: 必要な物、お金が必要だ、必要がある
必要|ひつよう.tip: Noun + が必要です: I need it. Verb + 必要がある: it is necessary to. 要る (N5) is the plain verb to need.

ひどい|ひどい.usage: ひどい雨、ひどいことを言う
ひどい|ひどい.tip: Strong bad: ひどい雨 (heavy rain), ひどい点 (an awful score), ひどい人 (a cruel person). 大変 is big trouble; ひどい adds a sting of disapproval.
ひどい|ひどい.notes: Kana spelling of 酷い (beyond N4).

開く|ひらく.usage: 本を開く、店を開く、パーティーを開く
開く|ひらく.tip: Same kanji as 開く あく (N5, a door opens by itself) and 開ける あける (you open a door). ひらく is flat things opening wide (book, flower, shop) and holding events: 会議を開く. Works both ways: 花が開く, 本を開く.
開く|ひらく.notes: Separate item from N5 開く|あく; JMdict lists it as both transitive and intransitive. Primary gloss carries the objects to keep it apart from 開く あく (to open (by itself)) and 開ける (to open (something)).

昼間|ひるま.tip: 昼 (N5) alone can mean noon or lunch; 昼間 is specifically the daytime hours as opposed to night (夜).

昼休み|ひるやすみ.tip: 昼 (noon) + 休み (break). The break itself; the meal is 昼ご飯.

拾う|ひろう.usage: ごみを拾う、財布を拾う
拾う|ひろう.tip: Picking something up off the ground: 財布を拾った. 取る (N5) is taking in general. Opposite: 捨てる (to throw away). タクシーを拾う: to hail a taxi.

増える|ふえる.usage: 人口が増える、体重が増える
増える|ふえる.tip: Intransitive: 人が増えた (the number of people grew). 増やす is increasing it yourself. Opposite: 減る (to decrease).

深い|ふかい.tip: Opposite of 浅い (shallow). Works for water, forests, sleep (深い眠り), meaning and feelings.

複雑|ふくざつ.usage: 複雑な問題、複雑な気持ち
複雑|ふくざつ.tip: Opposite of 簡単 (simple). 複雑な気持ち: mixed feelings.

復習|ふくしゅう.tip: 復習する: go over what you have learned. 予習する is preparing a lesson in advance. The pair 予習・復習 is the classic study advice.

部長|ぶちょう.tip: Company ranks, high to low: 社長 (president), 部長 (department head), 課長 (section manager). At school, 部長 is the captain of a club (部活).

普通|ふつう.usage: 普通の人、普通は、普通電車
普通|ふつう.tip: 普通の〜: an ordinary one. 普通は: usually. On the railway, 普通 is the slowest train, stopping at every station (then 急行, then 特急).
普通|ふつう.notes: JMdict's first sense is noun-no / na-adjective, the second adverb; set adj-na as the headline pos, adverb use in the tip.

ぶどう|ぶどう.notes: Kana spelling of 葡萄 (beyond N4); often katakana ブドウ.

太る|ふとる.tip: Mostly in the past or ている: 太った (put on weight), 太っている (is overweight). Opposite: 痩せる. 太い (N5) is the adjective thick or fat.

布団|ふとん.usage: 布団を敷く、布団をたたむ
布団|ふとん.tip: The mattress (敷き布団) and the quilt (掛け布団) laid on tatami. 布団を敷く: lay out the futon; 布団をたたむ: fold it up.

舟|ふね.tip: Two kanji: 舟 is a small boat (rowing boat, fishing boat); 船 is a ship or large boat and the more common spelling. Same reading ふね.
舟|ふね.notes: JMdict files 舟 under the 船 entry (船 listed first). Tanos lists the spelling 舟 only; 船 is not in the N4 list, so no alt. Gloss leads with boat to match the 舟 nuance.

不便|ふべん.tip: 不 + 便利 (N5, convenient). Note the reading: べんり but ふべん, the り drops.
不便|ふべん.notes: Na-adjective like its opposite 便利 (JMdict: noun, na-adjective). senseOk after a manual read: JMdict gives the noun sense inconvenience, which the word-match misses against the adjective inconvenient.

踏む|ふむ.usage: 足を踏む、ブレーキを踏む
踏む|ふむ.tip: Often passive: 足を踏まれた (someone stepped on my foot). ブレーキを踏む: hit the brake.

降り出す|ふりだす.tip: 降る (N5, to fall) + 出す: to start doing. The pattern verb stem + 出す means something suddenly starts: 泣き出す (burst into tears), 走り出す (break into a run).
降り出す|ふりだす.notes: JMdict marks it not common, but Tanos lists it; verified against the JMdict entry.

文化|ぶんか.tip: 文化の日 (Culture Day) is 3 November, a public holiday.

文学|ぶんがく.tip: 文学部: faculty of letters / arts at a university.

別|べつ.usage: 別の日、別に、それとは別に
別|べつ.tip: 別の〜: a different one (別の店). 別に + negative: not particularly (別に何もない). 別々に: separately. Not to be confused with 違う (to differ).
別|べつ.notes: JMdict's first sense is the noun distinction; the everyday use is the na-adjective / の-adjective sense (another, separate), so pos adj-na. Different as a primary gloss is kept third since 違う is taught (verb, different pos family).

変|へん.tip: 変な〜: strange, off, suspicious. 変 alone is also the root of 変える / 変わる (to change). おかしい overlaps but also means funny ha-ha.

返事|へんじ.usage: 返事をする、返事を待つ
返事|へんじ.tip: 返事をする or 返事する: to reply, to answer when called. 答え is the answer to a question or test; 返事 is answering a person or letter.

貿易|ぼうえき.tip: Trade between countries: 貿易会社 (trading company). 商売 is business or trade in general.

法律|ほうりつ.tip: 法律を守る: obey the law; 法律に違反する: break the law. 法 alone appears in 文法 (grammar) and 方法 (method).

僕|ぼく.tip: Casual-to-neutral I for boys and men: fine with friends and in most offices, but 私 is safer in formal speech. Adults sometimes call a little boy 僕 (you).
僕|ぼく.notes: Primary gloss carries (used by men) to keep it apart from N5 私 (I / me).

ほとんど|ほとんど.usage: ほとんど毎日、ほとんど分からない
ほとんど|ほとんど.tip: Positive: ほとんど終わった (almost done). With a negative it flips: ほとんど食べない (hardly eats). Can also be a noun: ほとんどの人 (most people).
ほとんど|ほとんど.notes: Kana spelling of 殆ど (beyond N4).

ほめる|ほめる.tip: Often passive: ほめられる (to be praised). Opposite: 叱る (to scold).
ほめる|ほめる.notes: Kana spelling of 褒める (beyond N4).

翻訳|ほんやく.usage: 翻訳する、日本語に翻訳する
翻訳|ほんやく.tip: Written translation. Spoken interpreting is 通訳. 翻訳する takes に for the target language.

参る|まいる.usage: 明日参ります、お墓参り
参る|まいる.tip: Humble for 行く and 来る: すぐに参ります (I will come right away). Also: 参った (I give up / I am stumped). お参り: visiting a shrine, temple or grave.
参る|まいる.notes: Primary gloss combines go and come with (humble) so it does not equal N5 行く (to go) or 来る (to come); plain forms are still accepted.

負ける|まける.tip: Takes に for the winner: 兄に負けた (lost to my brother). Opposite: 勝つ (to win). Losing an object is 無くす, not 負ける. In a market, 負けてください asks for a discount.

または|または.tip: Written-style or, between nouns or clauses: 月曜または火曜. In speech それとも asks a choice (A? それとも B?) and か joins nouns (AかB).
または|または.notes: Kana spelling of 又は; kanji rarely used. senseOk after a manual read: JMdict sense is or / either ... or; the word-match drops or as a stop word.

間違える|まちがえる.usage: 道を間違える、答えを間違える
間違える|まちがえる.tip: Transitive: 漢字を間違えた (got the kanji wrong). 間違う / 間違っている is the state of being wrong. The noun 間違い: a mistake.

間に合う|まにあう.usage: 電車に間に合う、間に合わない
間に合う|まにあう.tip: Takes に: 授業に間に合った (made it to class in time). Negative 間に合わない: too late / will not make it. Also: これで間に合う (this will do).

周り|まわり.tip: Noun + の周り: around it (駅の周り). 周りの人: the people around you. Written 回り it is a turn or rotation (遠回り).

回る|まわる.tip: Intransitive: 時計の針が回る (hands turn). 回す is turning it. 〜を回る with a place: 京都を回る (tour around Kyoto).

漫画|まんが.tip: Often katakana マンガ. アニメ is the animated version.

真中|まんなか.usage: 真ん中に立つ、町の真ん中
真中|まんなか.tip: Right in the middle, more exact than 中 (inside, N5): 部屋の真ん中 (the very centre of the room). 真 (true) + ん + 中.
真中|まんなか.notes: UNSURE: the Tanos list spells it 真中 but JMdict and everyday writing use 真ん中; set jmWord to the JMdict form so the check matches. The orchestrator may prefer to rename the key to 真ん中|まんなか.

見える|みえる.usage: 山が見える、若く見える
見える|みえる.tip: Takes が: 富士山が見える (Mt Fuji is visible / I can see it). 見られる is the potential (allowed or able to watch). Adjective + 見える: to look: 若く見える, 元気そうに見える.

湖|みずうみ.tip: 水 (water) + 海 (sea): a sea of water. Smaller still is 池 (pond, N5).

味噌|みそ.tip: 味噌汁 (miso soup) is the everyday use. Also the key point of something: ここが味噌だ.

見つかる|みつかる.usage: かぎが見つかった、仕事が見つかる
見つかる|みつかる.tip: Intransitive: 財布が見つかった (the wallet turned up). 見つける is you finding it. Also being caught: 先生に見つかった (the teacher caught me).

見つける|みつける.usage: 仕事を見つける、間違いを見つける
見つける|みつける.tip: Transitive: いい店を見つけた (found a good shop). 見つかる is the thing being found. 探す is searching; 見つける is the moment you succeed.

皆|みな.tip: 皆 みな is a touch more formal than みんな (N5); in writing it is the same kanji. Add さん for addressing a group: 皆さん (N5).
皆|みな.notes: JMdict lists both みな and みんな under 皆; alsoRead covers the N5 kana word. Primary gloss everybody keeps it apart from N5 皆さん and みんな (everyone).

港|みなと.tip: Sea port. Airports borrow the kanji: 空港 (sky port). Place names: 横浜港, 港区.

向かう|むかう.usage: 駅に向かう、机に向かう
向かう|むかう.tip: Takes に or へ: 空港へ向かう (head for the airport). 机に向かう: sit facing the desk (get down to work). 向こう (N5) is the other side.

迎える|むかえる.usage: 駅で友達を迎える、お客さんを迎える
迎える|むかえる.tip: Transitive: 駅に父を迎えに行く (go to pick up my father at the station). 迎えに行く / 迎えに来る are the stock phrases. 送る is seeing someone off, the opposite.

昔|むかし.tip: 昔は〜 : back in the old days. 昔々 (once upon a time) opens folk tales. 昔の友達: an old friend.

虫|むし.tip: Any small creepy-crawly, insects and worms alike. 虫歯 (a cavity) is a tooth bug.

息子|むすこ.tip: Your own son is 息子; someone else's is 息子さん. The daughter pair: 娘 / 娘さん.

娘|むすめ.tip: Your own daughter is 娘; someone else's is 娘さん or お嬢さん. Can also mean a young unmarried woman. The son pair: 息子 / 息子さん.

無理|むり.usage: 無理です、無理をする、無理に
無理|むり.tip: 無理です is the soft no: I can't, that is impossible. 無理をする: push yourself too hard (無理しないで, take it easy). 無理に: by force, against someone's will.

召し上がる|めしあがる.usage: どうぞ召し上がってください
召し上がる|めしあがる.tip: Honorific of 食べる and 飲む, for a guest or superior: 召し上がってください (please help yourself). Your own eating is the humble いただく.
召し上がる|めしあがる.notes: Primary gloss combines eat and drink with (honorific) so it does not equal N5 食べる (to eat) or 飲む (to drink).

珍しい|めずらしい.usage: 珍しい花、珍しいですね
珍しい|めずらしい.tip: 珍しいですね: that is unusual (for you), said when someone does something out of character. Also rare and precious: 珍しい物.

申し上げる|もうしあげる.tip: Humble of 言う, politer than 申す. Stock phrases: お礼を申し上げます (I thank you), お詫び申し上げます (I apologise). お + verb stem + 申し上げる: お願い申し上げます.
申し上げる|もうしあげる.notes: Primary gloss carries (humble) so it does not equal N5 言う (to say / to tell).

申す|もうす.tip: Humble of 言う. The main use is introducing yourself: 田中と申します (my name is Tanaka). For saying things to a superior, 申し上げる is politer still.
申す|もうす.notes: Primary gloss carries (humble) so it does not equal N5 言う.

もうすぐ|もうすぐ.usage: もうすぐ春です、もうすぐ着く
もうすぐ|もうすぐ.tip: もう (already) + すぐ (right away, N5): just about to. もうすぐ着きます (arriving any minute). そろそろ is about time to.
もうすぐ|もうすぐ.notes: Kana spelling of もう直ぐ. JMdict labels expression / adverb; pos adverb.

もし|もし.tip: もし goes at the start and the real if is the verb ending: もし雨なら / 降ったら / 降れば. もし alone cannot make a condition. もしも is a stronger, more hypothetical もし.
もし|もし.notes: Kana spelling of 若し. The cache file's first entry is this adverb (若し/もし, common, N4); the lower entries (模試 mock exam, もし excuse me) are different words. UNSURE whether the build picks the first entry by reading or needs q; keyword もし returns the right entry first.

戻る|もどる.usage: 席に戻る、家に戻る、すぐ戻ります
戻る|もどる.tip: Going back to where you were a moment ago: すぐ戻ります (be right back). 帰る (N5) is going home. 返す (N5) is giving something back; 戻す is putting something back.

木綿|もめん.tip: 木綿 もめん is cotton cloth; コットン is the loanword you see on labels. 絹 is silk.
木綿|もめん.notes: The reading きわた (the tree) is a different sense and not accepted.

森|もり.tip: Three trees: a deep forest. 林 (two trees) is smaller woods. 森林 (しんりん) puts both together for forests in general.

焼く|やく.usage: 魚を焼く、パンを焼く、ごみを焼く
焼く|やく.tip: Transitive: 肉を焼く (grill meat). 焼ける is the food cooking by itself or a building burning down. One verb covers grill, bake, roast and toast; 焼き鳥, 焼きそば, たこ焼き all come from it.

約束|やくそく.usage: 約束を守る、約束する、友達と約束がある
約束|やくそく.tip: 約束する: to promise; 約束を守る / 破る: keep / break a promise. Also plans with a person: 友達と約束がある (I have plans with a friend). A booking is 予約.

役に立つ|やくにたつ.usage: 役に立つ本、役に立たない
役に立つ|やくにたつ.tip: Literally stands in a role. 役に立つ本: a useful book. 役に立たない: useless. 便利 is convenient (a thing); 役に立つ is being of use to someone.
役に立つ|やくにたつ.notes: JMdict labels it expression + godan verb (立つ conjugates); pos verb-godan so it conjugates like 立つ.

焼ける|やける.usage: パンが焼けた、家が焼けた、日に焼ける
焼ける|やける.tip: Intransitive pair of 焼く: パンが焼けた (the bread is done), 家が焼けた (the house burned down), 日に焼ける (get a tan). The cook grills; the food 焼ける.

優しい|やさしい.tip: Same sound as 易しい (easy, N5) but a different kanji: 優 is a kind person, 易 is an easy problem. 親切 is kindness in deeds; 優しい is a gentle nature.

痩せる|やせる.usage: 三キロ痩せた、痩せている
痩せる|やせる.tip: 痩せている: is thin (a state). 痩せた: lost weight. Opposite: 太る. Often in kana やせる.

やっと|やっと.usage: やっと終わった、やっと間に合った
やっと|やっと.tip: Relief after a struggle: やっと分かった (I finally get it). Also barely: やっと間に合った (only just made it). とうとう is the sigh of something finally happening; ようやく is やっと in more formal clothes.
やっと|やっと.notes: Kana spelling of 漸と. Primary gloss differs from とうとう (finally).

止む|やむ.tip: Intransitive, for things that were going on by themselves: 雨が止む, 音が止む. People or cars stopping are 止まる (N5). Often written in kana: やむ.
止む|やむ.notes: Primary gloss carries the subjects so it does not equal N5 止まる (to stop).

止める|やめる.usage: タバコをやめる、会社を辞める、やめてください
止める|やめる.tip: Transitive, an activity: 仕事をやめる, タバコをやめる. Usually in kana. Written 辞める it is quitting a job. 止める read とめる stops a thing (a car); 止まる is it stopping by itself.
止める|やめる.notes: Same kanji as 止める|とめる (own item), different word. JMdict lists 止める / 已める / 廃める; 辞める (resign) is a separate entry.

柔らかい|やわらかい.usage: 柔らかいパン、柔らかい肉
柔らかい|やわらかい.tip: Opposite of 固い / 硬い (hard). Soft food, soft cushions, a soft voice. Also written 軟らかい.

湯|ゆ.usage: お湯を沸かす、お湯に入る
湯|ゆ.tip: Almost always お湯. Japanese splits water by temperature: 水 is cold water, お湯 is hot. お湯を沸かす: boil water. The ゆ sign on a curtain marks a public bath.

指|ゆび.tip: One word for fingers and toes; say 足の指 to be clear. 親指 thumb, 人差し指 index finger, 小指 little finger.

指輪|ゆびわ.tip: 指 (finger) + 輪 (ring, hoop). To wear a ring: 指輪をする or 指輪をはめる.

夢|ゆめ.tip: Both kinds of dream: the one at night (夢を見る, to have a dream) and the one for the future (将来の夢). 夢のよう: like a dream.

揺れる|ゆれる.usage: 地震で家が揺れる、電車が揺れる
揺れる|ゆれる.tip: Intransitive: 地面が揺れた (the ground shook). 揺らす is shaking something. The first word on everyone's lips in an earthquake.

用|よう.usage: 用がある、何の用ですか、子供用
用|よう.tip: 用がある: I have something to do / I need you. 何の用ですか: what do you want. As a suffix, noun + 用: for the use of: 子供用 (for children), 女性用. 用事 is the fuller word for an errand.
用|よう.notes: JMdict noun; the standalone use (用がある) is common enough that it is not filed as bound, the suffix use goes in usage and the tip.

用意|ようい.usage: 食事を用意する、用意ができた
用意|ようい.tip: 用意する: to prepare, get something ready. 準備 is nearly the same, a little more formal and longer term; 支度 is getting yourself ready (clothes, a meal). 用意、どん: ready, go.

用事|ようじ.tip: 用事があるので帰ります: I have something to do, so I'm heading home. A common, vague way to excuse yourself.
用事|ようじ.notes: Near synonym of 用|よう (part 3), whose gloss also lists errand; 用事 is the fuller everyday word.

汚れる|よごれる.tip: Intransitive: 服が汚れた (the clothes got dirty). Making something dirty is 汚す; dirty as an adjective is 汚い.

予習|よしゅう.tip: 予習 is studying before the class; 復習 is reviewing after it.

予定|よてい.usage: 明日の予定、行く予定です
予定|よてい.tip: Verb + 予定です: is scheduled to (三時に着く予定です). 予定 is what is on the calendar; 計画 is a larger plan you work out.

予約|よやく.usage: レストランを予約する

寄る|よる.tip: Mostly stopping somewhere on the way: コンビニに寄る. Do not mix it up with 夜 (night), also read よる.

喜ぶ|よろこぶ.tip: 喜ぶ describes someone's visible joy (母はとても喜んだ). For your own feeling right now, say 嬉しい.

利用|りよう.tip: 利用する is a more formal 使う, for services and facilities: バスを利用する.
利用|りよう.notes: 'to use' left out of accept: it is the primary gloss of N5 使う.

両方|りょうほう.tip: 両方とも: both of them. Only one of a pair is 片方.

旅館|りょかん.tip: A traditional inn with tatami rooms, futons and usually dinner and breakfast. A Western-style hotel is ホテル.

留守|るす.usage: 父は留守です、留守番電話
留守|るす.tip: 留守 is about not being home: 家を留守にする (to leave the house empty). 留守番電話 is an answering machine.

冷房|れいぼう.tip: 冷房 cools the room and 暖房 heats it. エアコン is the machine that does both.

連絡|れんらく.usage: 後で連絡します、電話で連絡する

沸かす|わかす.usage: お湯を沸かす、お風呂を沸かす
沸かす|わかす.tip: Transitive: お湯を沸かす (you boil it). Intransitive pair: お湯が沸く (it boils). お風呂を沸かす heats the bath.

別れる|わかれる.tip: Takes と: 彼と別れた (broke up with him). 分かれる, same sound, means to be divided into parts.

沸く|わく.tip: Intransitive: お湯が沸いた (the water boiled). You boil it with 沸かす.

訳|わけ.tip: どういう訳: what's the reason. In grammar it is usually kana: ～わけだ (that explains it), ～わけではない (it is not that). 言い訳 is an excuse.
訳|わけ.notes: 'reason' alone kept for 理由; 'meaning' alone is N5 意味, 'cause' is 原因.

忘れ物|わすれもの.tip: 忘れ物をする: to leave something behind. 忘れ物はありませんか: have you got everything?

笑う|わらう.tip: 笑う covers both laughing and smiling. ～を笑う is laughing at someone. A smiling face is 笑顔.

割合|わりあい.tip: As a noun: a ratio (男女の割合). As an adverb, 割合(に) means comparatively: 割合安い (fairly cheap).

割れる|われる.tip: Intransitive, for glass and dishes: 皿が割れた. You break it with 割る. A machine that stops working is 壊れる.

アルコール|アルコール.notes: Primary 'alcohol' overlaps N5 お酒; the loanword means exactly this, so kept.

アルバイト|アルバイト.tip: Shortened to バイト in speech. Students do アルバイト; パート is part-time work by adults.

オートバイ|オートバイ.tip: In everyday speech バイク is more common.

ガラス|ガラス.tip: The material. A drinking glass is コップ or グラス.

ソフト|ソフト.tip: ソフト is also short for software (ゲームのソフト). ソフトクリーム is soft-serve ice cream.
ソフト|ソフト.notes: JMdict lists na-adjective first (soft), then software; pos from JMdict. 'gentle' left out: primary gloss of 優しい.

タイプ|タイプ.tip: 好きなタイプ: the kind of person you go for. 彼は私のタイプじゃない: he's not my type.

パート|パート.tip: パート is part-time work, often by adults with a family; students do アルバイト. In music it is a part (ピアノのパート).
パート|パート.notes: 'part-time job' left out of accept: primary gloss of アルバイト.

ビル|ビル.tip: A large concrete building of several floors. It is not a bill to pay: that is お会計.
ビル|ビル.notes: JMdict also has a rare ビル = bill (invoice); the common entry is building.

レポート|レポート.tip: At school, a written assignment. Also spelled リポート, which is more usual for a news report. Also spelled リポート.
レポート|レポート.notes: The list's リポート is the same JMdict entry; skipped, mentioned in the tip.

伺う|うかがう.notes: 伺 is not an N4 kanji, so the kana key うかがう is taught.

内|うち.usage: 若いうちに、三人のうち
内|うち.tip: Usually written in kana. ～うちに: while it is still so (熱いうちに食べて). ～のうち: among (三人のうち一人). N5 うち (home) is a different word.
内|うち.notes: 'inside' left out of accept: primary gloss of N5 うち|うち. JMdict entry 内/中 うち, noun and adverb.

うまい|うまい.usage: 歌がうまい、このラーメンはうまい
うまい|うまい.tip: Casual for both 上手 (good at) and おいしい (tasty); the tasty sense sounds rough and is mostly men's speech. Kanji 上手い / 美味い exist but kana is usual.
うまい|うまい.notes: Kana key; JMdict entry 上手い/美味い/旨い. 'delicious' left out of accept: primary gloss of N5 おいしい.

事|こと.usage: 大事なこと、見たことがある
事|こと.tip: An abstract thing: a matter, event or fact. A physical thing is 物. In grammar it is kana: 見たことがある (have seen), 泳ぐことができる (can swim).

叱る|しかる.tip: Often passive: 叱られる (to get scolded). Opposite: ほめる (to praise).

邪魔|じゃま.usage: お邪魔します、邪魔になる
邪魔|じゃま.tip: お邪魔します: the set phrase on entering someone's home. 邪魔をする: to get in someone's way.

随分|ずいぶん.tip: Adds a note of surprise: ずいぶん大きくなったね (you've grown a lot!). Often written in kana.
随分|ずいぶん.notes: JMdict adverb first. 'very' (N5 とても), 'quite' (N5 結構) and 'extremely' (非常に) left out. Primary considerably also appears in 大分 (part 2).

空く|すく.usage: 電車が空いている、おなかが空く
空く|すく.tip: 空いている: not crowded (電車が空いている). おなかが空く: to get hungry. Read あく, the same kanji means a seat or room becomes free.
空く|すく.notes: Separate JMdict entry from 空く|あく (part 1). 'to become empty' left out: part 1's primary gloss there.

素晴らしい|すばらしい.notes: 'splendid' left out: N5 立派. 'amazing' left out: すごい.

是非|ぜひ.tip: Strengthens a wish or invitation: ぜひ来てください (please do come). ぜひ行きたい (I'd love to go). Often written in kana.
是非|ぜひ.notes: JMdict adverb sense is first (the noun 'right and wrong' is a later sense); pos set explicitly. 'certainly' alone kept for もちろん.

全然|ぜんぜん.tip: Normally with a negative: 全然分からない (I don't understand at all). Casual speech also uses it for very: 全然大丈夫.

大抵|たいてい.notes: 抵 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key たいてい (part 2) is taught. Pos adverb to match it.

月|つき.tip: Read つき alone: the moon, or a month as a span (月に一回 once a month). In dates it is がつ (一月) and in counts げつ (一か月).

通り|とおり.usage: 大通り、言ったとおりに
通り|とおり.tip: As a place: a street (大通り, main street). After a verb: 言ったとおり (just as I said), often in kana. After a noun it becomes どおり: 予定どおり (as planned).
通り|とおり.notes: 'road' and 'street' are N5 道's glosses, so the primary is avenue / main street.

匂い|におい.tip: 匂いがする: there is a smell. 匂い is usually a nice smell; an unpleasant one is often written 臭い (same reading).

濡れる|ぬれる.notes: 濡 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key ぬれる (part 3) is taught.

値段|ねだん.notes: 値 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key ねだん (part 3) is taught.

熱心|ねっしん.usage: 熱心に勉強する、熱心な先生

喉|のど.tip: 喉が渇いた: I'm thirsty (literally, my throat is dry). 喉が痛い: I have a sore throat.

程|ほど.usage: 三十分ほど、去年ほど寒くない
程|ほど.tip: After a number: about (三十分ほど). With a negative: not as ... as (去年ほど寒くない). Usually written in kana.

褒める|ほめる.notes: 褒 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key ほめる (part 3) is taught.

真面目|まじめ.tip: A person who works properly and keeps the rules. Also not joking: まじめな話 (seriously, though). Often written in kana.

最も|もっとも.tip: A formal 一番: 日本で最も高い山 (the highest mountain in Japan).

オーバー|オーバー.usage: 時間をオーバーする、オーバーな話
オーバー|オーバー.tip: Three uses: an overcoat, going over a limit (予算をオーバーする), and as a na-adjective exaggerated (オーバーに言う).
オーバー|オーバー.notes: 'coat' left out of accept: primary gloss of N5 コート. JMdict lists noun (overcoat) first.

再来月|さらいげつ.notes: 再 is not an N4 kanji; the list's さ来月 (part 2) is taught and matched to JMdict via jmWord.

再来週|さらいしゅう.notes: 再 is not an N4 kanji; the list's さ来週 (part 2) is taught and matched to JMdict via jmWord.

点く|つく.tip: Intransitive: 電気がつく (the light comes on). Turning it on yourself is つける. Usually written in kana.
点く|つく.notes: Separate JMdict entry from 付く (part 2) and N5 着く.

床屋|とこや.notes: 床 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key とこや (part 3) is taught.

赤ちゃん|あかちゃん.tip: The everyday word. 赤ん坊 is a plainer equivalent.
赤ちゃん|あかちゃん.notes: Taught spelling (赤 is on the N4 kanji list); part 1's あかちゃん carries alt here.

この間|このあいだ.tip: この間はありがとうございました: thanks for the other day (a set phrase when you next meet).
この間|このあいだ.notes: JMdict noun and adverb; set to adverb to match part 2's このあいだ, which carries alt here. Also read このかん (in the meantime), formal, not taught.

この頃|このごろ.notes: 頃 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key このごろ (part 2) is taught.

区|く.tip: A ward of a big city, mostly glued to a name: 港区. 区役所 is the ward office.
区|く.notes: JMdict noun; mostly bound, so contexts are given (as part 2 did for 市).

やはり|やはり.tip: やっぱり is the more spoken form. やっぱり～にします: on second thought, I'll take ~. In speech it is usually やっぱり.
やはり|やはり.notes: The list's やっぱり is the same JMdict entry; skipped, mentioned in the tip.

会|かい.tip: On its own: a meeting or party (会に出る). Mostly in compounds: 運動会 (sports day), 音楽会 (concert).
会|かい.notes: JMdict noun and noun-suffix; contexts given for the common bound use. 'party' alone left out: N5 パーティー.

うかがう|うかがう.usage: 明日うかがいます、ちょっとうかがいますが
うかがう|うかがう.tip: Humble verb for your own action toward someone above you: visiting (お宅にうかがう), asking or hearing. Written 伺う in kanji.
うかがう|うかがう.notes: 伺 is not an N4 kanji, so the kana key is taught; 伺う|うかがう carries alt here. JMdict also has 窺う (to peek), uncommon, a different word.

運動|うんどう.tip: 運動する: to exercise. 運動会 is a school sports day.
運動|うんどう.notes: 'sports' left out: primary gloss of N5 スポーツ.

心配|しんぱい.usage: 心配しないで、ご心配なく
心配|しんぱい.tip: 心配する: to worry (about): 母が心配している. ご心配なく: please don't worry.

ございます|ございます.tip: The very polite ある: トイレは二階にございます (the toilet is on the second floor). It also sits inside set phrases: おはようございます, ありがとうございます.
ございます|ございます.notes: Kana key (御座います); JMdict lists expression first, pos left as JMdict's.

だめ|だめ.usage: だめです、行ってはだめ
だめ|だめ.tip: ～てはだめ: you must not (ここで泳いではだめ). Said alone: no, that won't do. Kanji 駄目 exists, kana is usual.
だめ|だめ.notes: Kana key (駄 is not an N4 kanji); JMdict na-adjective.

正月|しょうがつ.tip: Usually お正月: the first days of January, Japan's main family holiday.

失礼|しつれい.tip: 失礼します: said when entering or leaving a room (a teacher's office) or ending a call. 失礼ですが: excuse me, but (before a personal question).

ごみ|ごみ.tip: Also written ゴミ. Japan sorts it by type on set days: 燃えるごみ (burnable), 燃えないごみ.
ごみ|ごみ.notes: Kana key; JMdict entry ゴミ/塵/芥.

製|せい.tip: Noun + 製: made in a country (日本製) or made of a material (木製, wooden).
製|せい.notes: JMdict noun used as a suffix; bound.

軒|けん.tip: Counts houses and shops. Sound changes: いっけん, さんげん, ろっけん, はっけん, じゅっけん, なんげん.
軒|けん.notes: JMdict suffix / counter (けん entry; the common 軒 のき, eaves, is another word). Set to counter. さんげん / なんげん are the standard readings, さんけん / なんけん also heard (accepted as alt).

学部|がくぶ.tip: A university division: 文学部 (faculty of letters), 医学部 (medical school).

できるだけ|できるだけ.usage: できるだけ早く来てください
できるだけ|できるだけ.tip: できるだけ + adverb: as ... as possible (できるだけ早く, as soon as possible).
できるだけ|できるだけ.notes: JMdict lists expression, adverb and no-noun; taught as the adverb it is used as.

嘘|うそ.tip: To tell a lie is 嘘をつく. Said alone, うそ! is like no way! or you're kidding.

式|しき.tip: Mostly in compounds: 結婚式 (wedding), 入学式 (school entrance ceremony). After a name, a style or system: 日本式.
式|しき.notes: JMdict noun and noun-suffix; contexts given for the bound uses.

出席|しゅっせき.tip: 出席する: to attend a class or meeting. Absence is 欠席.

家|か.tip: Noun + 家: someone who does it as a profession: 作家 (writer), 画家 (painter). Alone the kanji reads いえ (house, N5).
家|か.notes: JMdict suffix entry 家|か (-ist; -er). Bound.

建て|だて.tip: Number + 階建て: how many floors a building has. 一戸建て is a stand-alone house.
建て|だて.notes: JMdict suffix entry 建て|だて; bound.

頑張る|がんばる.tip: 頑張って! is a cheer: good luck, go for it. 頑張ります: I'll do my best. Often written in kana.

準備|じゅんび.tip: 準備する: to prepare. Everyday getting ready to go out or cook is also 支度.

パパ|パパ.tip: Childlike or affectionate. Talking about your own father to others, adults say 父.
パパ|パパ.notes: 'father' and 'dad' left out: N5 父 / お父さん.

もらう|もらう.tip: The giver takes に or から: 友達に本をもらった. ～てもらう: to have someone do something for you.
もらう|もらう.notes: Kana key (貰 is not an N4 kanji).

員|いん.tip: Noun + 員: a member or worker of it: 会社員 (office worker), 店員 (shop staff).
員|いん.notes: JMdict noun and noun-suffix; set to suffix since it only occurs bound (as part 1 did for 以下).

頂く|いただく.usage: いただきます、先生にいただいた本
頂く|いただく.tip: Humble もらう (先生に本をいただいた) and humble 食べる / 飲む. いただきます before a meal comes from it. Often written in kana.

もちろん|もちろん.tip: Answering a request: もちろん! (of course!). Kanji 勿論 exists but kana is usual.

けがする|けがする.tip: The noun けが (怪我) is an injury; illness is 病気. 足をけがした: I hurt my leg.
けがする|けがする.notes: List key is the する verb; JMdict entry 怪我|けが (noun, suru verb), matched via q/jmWord/jmReading like N5 コピーする. The cached けがする.json only returns 毛.

ばかり|ばかり.usage: 肉ばかり食べる、来たばかり
ばかり|ばかり.tip: Noun + ばかり: nothing but (ゲームばかり). Past verb + ばかり: just did (食べたばかり). Number + ばかり: about.
ばかり|ばかり.notes: Kana key (許り); JMdict particle. 'only' alone left out: N5 だけ.

だす|だす.tip: Verb stem + だす: to suddenly start (泣きだす, to burst out crying). Also written 出す. On its own N5 出す means to take out.
だす|だす.notes: UNSURE: the kana key is read as the auxiliary ～出す (JMdict 出す sense: suffix, to begin to), since N5 already teaches 出す|だす as a verb. If the list meant plain 出す, skip it as covered by N5 instead.

挨拶|あいさつ.tip: Everyday greetings (おはよう, さようなら) are all 挨拶. It is also a short formal speech at an event.

運転|うんてん.tip: 運転する: to drive. A driver is 運転手.

案内|あんない.tip: 案内する: to guide or show someone around. 案内所 is an information desk.

連れる|つれる.tip: Mostly as 連れて行く (take someone along) and 連れて来る (bring someone). For things, use 持って行く / 持って来る.

招待|しょうたい.usage: パーティーに招待する、招待状
招待|しょうたい.tip: 招待する: to invite (formally). 招待状 is an invitation card.

よろしい|よろしい.usage: これでよろしいですか
よろしい|よろしい.tip: The polite いい: これでよろしいですか (is this all right?). よろしければ: if you like.

彼ら|かれら.tip: 彼 (he) + ら (plural). Used for men or mixed groups; for women only, 彼女たち.

一杯|いっぱい.notes: 杯 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key いっぱい (part 1) is taught and covers the one-cup sense in its tip.

中々|なかなか.usage: なかなかおいしい、バスがなかなか来ない
中々|なかなか.tip: Positive: なかなかおいしい (pretty good, better than expected). With a negative: なかなか来ない (just won't come). Usually kana.
中々|なかなか.notes: JMdict adverb first. 'very' (N5 とても) and 'quite' (N5 結構) left out.

やすい|やすい.usage: 読みやすい、分かりやすい
やすい|やすい.tip: Verb stem + やすい: easy to do (読みやすい) or apt to happen (壊れやすい). Opposite: ～にくい. 安い (cheap, N5) is another word.
やすい|やすい.notes: N5 teaches 安い|やすい (cheap); the kana key is read as the suffix 易い (JMdict: suffix / i-adjective, easy to ...).

びっくりする|びっくりする.tip: Casual and very common: びっくりした! (what a surprise / you scared me). More formal: 驚く.
びっくりする|びっくりする.notes: List key is the する verb; JMdict entry 吃驚|びっくり (suru verb, adverb), matched via q/jmReading. The cached びっくりする.json returns only びっくりするほど.

計画|けいかく.tip: 計画を立てる: to make a plan. 予定 is what is on your schedule.

ハンバーグ|ハンバーグ.tip: A patty served on a plate with sauce, no bun. A burger in a bun is ハンバーガー.

支度|したく.usage: 出かける支度、食事の支度
支度|したく.tip: Everyday getting ready: 出かける支度 (getting ready to go out), 食事の支度 (making a meal). 準備 is the general, more formal word.

まず|まず.tip: Opens a sequence: まず～、次に～ (first ..., next ...).

まま|まま.usage: そのまま、靴のまま入る
まま|まま.tip: Keeps a state going: 電気をつけたまま寝た (slept with the light on). そのままで: just as it is.

専門|せんもん.tip: 専門は何ですか: what is your field / major? 専門家 is an expert.

承知|しょうち.usage: 承知しました、ご承知のとおり
承知|しょうち.tip: 承知しました: the polite I understand / certainly (to a customer or boss). More formal than 分かりました.

おわる|おわる.usage: 読みおわる、食べおわる
おわる|おわる.tip: Verb stem + おわる: to finish doing (宿題を書きおわった). Usually written 終わる: 読み終わる. On its own N5 終わる means to end.
おわる|おわる.notes: UNSURE: N5 already teaches 終わる|おわる (to end). The kana key is read as the auxiliary ～終わる (JMdict 終わる sense: suffix, to finish doing). If the list meant plain 終わる, skip it as covered by N5.

くださる|くださる.usage: 先生がくださった本、教えてくださる
くださる|くださる.tip: Honorific くれる: someone above you gives to you (先生が本をくださった). The request ～てください comes from it.
くださる|くださる.notes: Kana key (下さる); JMdict godan (-aru special class).

お子さん|おこさん.usage: お子さんは何歳ですか
お子さん|おこさん.tip: Polite, for another person's child. Your own child is 子供 or 子.

様|さま.tip: The very polite さん: on letters, to customers (お客様), and in set phrases (お疲れ様). Never for yourself.
様|さま.notes: JMdict suffix entry 様|さま (the other key 様|よう is a different entry). Bound.

代|だい.tip: Noun + 代: the charge for it (電気代, タクシー代). Number + 代: an age range (二十代, in one's twenties) or an era (1990年代).
代|だい.notes: JMdict entry 代|だい: noun and noun-suffix; set to suffix since it occurs bound. 'price' left out: ねだん.

contexts: [一|いっ][週間|しゅうかん]おき
おき|おき.tip: Number + おき: skipping that many in between. 一日おき = every other day; 二日おき = every third day. Also written 置き.
おき|おき.notes: Kana key; JMdict suffix entry 置き|おき (the common おき 沖, open sea, is a different word, so pos is set).

ご|ご.tip: ご goes on Chinese-reading words (ご家族, ご連絡), お on most native words (お名前).
ご|ご.notes: JMdict prefix entry 御|ご, written in kana like お. Bound.

世話|せわ.usage: 犬の世話をする、お世話になりました
世話|せわ.tip: 世話をする: to take care of a pet or child. お世話になりました: thank you for everything you've done for me.

格好|かっこう.tip: 格好いい (often かっこいい): cool, good-looking. 変な格好: a strange outfit.

かまう|かまう.tip: Mostly negative: かまいません (I don't mind, it's fine). 窓を開けてもかまいませんか: do you mind if I open the window?
かまう|かまう.notes: Kana key (構 is not an N4 kanji).

出発|しゅっぱつ.notes: 'to leave' left out of accept: N5 出る.

経験|けいけん.tip: 経験がある: to have experience. For something you did once, the grammar ～たことがある is more usual.

町|ちょう.tip: Same kanji as まち (town, N5). ちょう is its reading in compounds and in official names of towns and blocks.
町|ちょう.notes: JMdict noun 町|ちょう; mostly bound, so contexts given.

看護婦|かんごふ.tip: Today the neutral 看護師 is the standard term; 看護婦 is older and means a woman.

相談|そうだん.tip: 相談する: to talk something over with someone or ask their advice: 親に相談する.

食事|しょくじ.usage: 食事をする、食事に行く

お陰|おかげ.notes: 陰 is not an N4 kanji; the kana key おかげ (part 1) is taught.

にくい|にくい.usage: 読みにくい、分かりにくい
にくい|にくい.tip: Verb stem + にくい: hard to do. Opposite: ～やすい. On its own にくい (憎い) means hateful, another word.
にくい|にくい.notes: Kana key read as the suffix 難い (JMdict: suffix / i-adjective, difficult to ...).

嬉しい|うれしい.tip: Your own happiness about something that happened. For a lasting state (a happy life), use 幸せ.
